rv.q: Still, there are laughs to be had in this uneven comedy, especially in the outrageous orgy scene, which involves various permutations of the couples in the frenzied act of humping like … well, like rabbits.
It could also be because of Michael Shaw Fisher’s clunky script and his largely awkward direction, as well as some terrible acting.
In the end, The Amazing Sex Life of Rabbits succeeds as a quirky satire of wealth and power.

cn.t: Critics split on this sex comedy about desperate couples and parenthood, with some finding it smarmy and clunky while others deem it mildly amusing in its exploration of marriage, morals, and money.
